executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check on 2026-08-27 reviewed eight relevant items and found no confirmed material directional change. New capacity and improved yields could relieve pressure but will reach the market with a lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
